title.en: oedo antique market, tokyo international forum.
title.tr: tokyo international forum'da oedo antika pazarı.

line.en: a public holiday, so the market is busy. stalls open 9:00 to 16:00 with old prints, glassware and small things to dig through. it can be cancelled in bad weather.
line.de: ein feiertag, der markt ist also voll. die stände sind von 9:00 bis 16:00 offen, mit alten drucken, glaswaren und kleinen dingen zum durchstöbern. bei schlechtem wetter kann er ausfallen.
line.tr: resmi tatil olduğu için pazar kalabalık. standlar 09:00 ile 16:00 arası açık; eski baskılar, cam eşyalar ve küçük şeyler. kötü havada iptal edilebilir.

sparks.why: Oedo Antique Market listed for mon 23.11, 勤労感謝の日 public holiday, 9:00-16:00, free, at Tokyo International Forum (tokyocheapo.com calendar in search results).
